title: runtime/retry-config
description: RetryConfig contract object for checkpoint-reload retry loops (feature 003, specs/003-checkpoint-retry; FR-202, UR-RL-002). Versioned contract object: schema_version is required and deliberately unbounded above (consumer max is consumer policy per compatibility/VERSIONING.md). Declares the game-time window (window_ticks XOR window_hours; 2500 ticks per game-hour), the retry cap (max_retries bounds retries AFTER the first attempt, so total windows <= max_retries + 1), game speed (0-4), the namespaced checkpoint save family, references naming the success gate and mutation space (recorded in the run manifest and emitted events), and hard wall-clock budgets. The embedded `gate`/`mutation_space`/`candidate` blocks make the object self-contained and executable offline by components/lab; `sim` carries SimBridge parameters for offline runs. Debug/eval mode only: retry loops are forbidden during scored episodes (FR-208).

schema_version.description: Contract revision; no maximum (strict consumers enforce their own ceiling).

config_id.description: Retry-loop config identifier; rl.* kind per common/id grammar.

window_ticks.description: Game-time increment per iteration in ticks. XOR with window_hours.

window_hours.description: Game-time increment per iteration in game-hours (2500 ticks each). XOR with window_ticks.

max_retries.description: Hard cap on retries after the first attempt; total windows <= max_retries + 1 (FR-207).

speed.description: Game speed applied while advancing each window (bridge game.speed 0..4).

checkpoint_family.description: Namespaced save family; checkpoints are saved as <family>--<run_id>--cp<N> and isolated from user saves (FR-206).

gate_ref.description: Identifier naming the success gate; recorded in the run manifest and retry.gate.evaluated events. The embedded `gate` block carries the executable definition in v1.

mutation_space_ref.description: Identifier naming the declared mutation space; recorded for provenance. The embedded `mutation_space` list carries the executable definition in v1.

per_window_s.description: Wall-clock budget per window in seconds; exceeding aborts the loop (FR-207).

total_s.description: Wall-clock budget for the whole run in seconds; exceeding aborts the loop (FR-207).

budgets.description: Hard wall-clock bounds; the loop cannot self-extend them.

combinator.description: How predicate verdicts combine; default 'all' when omitted.

field.description: Dotted path into the observed state dict (numeric segments index lists).

value.description: Expected value compared against the observed field.

gate.description: Embedded executable gate definition (state predicates, never event equality). Required to run; optional when the config is used purely as a manifest.

path.description: Dotted path into the candidate plan dict (numeric segments index lists).

op.description: set: assign value at path; bump: add numeric value to numeric leaf; swap: exchange list elements at the [i,j] index pair in value.

value.description: Op operand: literal for set, numeric delta for bump, [i,j] index pair for swap.

mutation_space.description: Embedded ordered mutation list; one popped per retry, exhaustion ends the loop as 'exhausted' (FR-204).

candidate.description: Initial candidate plan/matrix dict the mutation space edits; mutations produce new revisions, never in-place pack edits (UR-RL-006).

sim.description: Optional SimBridge parameters for --mode sim runs ({state, wall_per_window_s, ...}); ignored by --mode live.
